# Investor update cadence: monthly update with metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **monthly** (email update on the first Monday) and will continue to include the metrics dashboard link.

## Why
Brightpath asked the team to slow down; revert to monthly cadence but keep the dashboard link.

This replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Maintains transparency while reducing update frequency per investor request.

# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by [[Maya Okafor]] and the product team.

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Sinch** (use EU region where possible). The migration will go live from 2026-11-01.

## Why
Vonage delivery failures continued for Portuguese numbers during the pilot.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Several clinics reported delivery issues with Vonage in Portugal. Reception teams continue to ask for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU region)

Decided on 2026-10-14 by [[Tom Lindqvist]] and [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog Cloud (EU region)**.

## Why
Self-hosted PostHog is taking too much ops time; PostHog Cloud (EU) keeps clinic data in the EU while reducing ops burden.

This replaces [[Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Switch agreed between Maya and Tom to reduce maintenance overhead.

# Release cadence: twice-weekly releases (Tuesdays and Thursdays)

Decided on 2026-10-15 by [[Tom Lindqvist]] and [[Daniel Reyes]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays**, still deployed behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics during the day; twice-weekly schedules reduce disruption while retaining feature-flagged delivery.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Agreed between Daniel and Tom on 2026-10-15.

# Weekly sync, 2026-10-13

Attendees: [[Maya Okafor]], [[Tom Lindqvist]], [[Priya Raman]], [[Daniel Reyes]], [[Sofia Marchetti]], [[Kenji Watanabe]]

- Launch recap: we launched publicly on 6 October as planned. Early feedback from clinics is good.
- SMS reminders: Vonage keeps failing on Portuguese numbers too. Agreed: we move SMS reminders to Sinch from 1 November. Vonage is out.
- Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout; that task is no longer needed.
- Action: Priya to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October.
- Support tool: Sofia floated moving from Plain to Zendesk. Not decided; Maya wants to see Plain's new pricing first. Revisit in December.
- Several receptionists asked again for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

## Actions
- [[Priya Raman]] to redesign SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30.
- [[Kenji Watanabe]] to stop the Vonage rollout and begin Sinch rollout planning.

Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

Weekly batches hid regressions.
